name: Stevenson Place
note: market-fidi.ts: 71 Stevenson, brown granite base with cream bands, cream-piered shaft, three setbacks, small gabled crown; from Commons Stevenson Place.jpg and Mapillary.

name: 1177 Market at Trinity Place
note: market-fidi.ts: 17-storey tan precast flats, punched bays, glazed strip, setback top; from Mapillary frames on Market and 8th.

name: Union Trust Bank Building
note: market-fidi.ts: 2 Grant, two-storey grey granite banking hall, giant engaged columns, arched windows, bracketed cornice, attic balustrade; from Mapillary frames at Market and Grant.

name: Serif (960 Market Street)
note: market-fidi.ts: 960 Market, 12-storey 2021 apartments, pale grey cladding in bowed bay windows, glazed ground floor under a cream band; from Mapillary frames on Market.

name: James Bong Building
note: market-fidi.ts: James Bong Building, 12-storey pre-war block of cream stone pilasters, terracotta ground storey, balustrade crown; from Mapillary frames at Fourth and Market.

name: 901 Market Street
note: market-fidi.ts: 901 Market, the old Hale Brothers store (1912), five-storey cream terracotta palazzo with shopfront base and strong cornice; Mapillary frames missed the front, modelled from the brief's gist.

name: Prism, 1028 Market Street
note: market-fidi.ts: Prism, 1028 Market, 13-storey 2010s apartments, cream panelled cladding in paired dark-framed ribbon windows, teal glazed ground floor, one setback; from Mapillary frames on Market and at Jones.

name: 945 Market Street (Livat)
note: market-fidi.ts: Livat, 945 Market, five-storey retail mall: dark-framed shopfront base, grey corrugated metal bands with louvred vents, grey parapet; from Mapillary frame at the Market front.

name: Bank of America Building (Market at New Montgomery)
note: market-fidi.ts: Bank of America Building, Market at New Montgomery: dark grey granite base of shops under a white-cream punched shaft in dark-framed columns, setback and dark parapet; from Mapillary frames on Market and New Montgomery (picks 0-2).

name: 715-719 Market Street (Digital Garage)
note: market-fidi.ts: 715-719 Market Street, Digital Garage: pre-war eight-storey office block, glazed shopfront under a stone band, grey ribbon-window shaft and stone-capped parapet; from Mapillary frames on Market (picks 0-1).

name: 500 Washington Street (Public Policy Institute of California)
note: market-fidi.ts: 500 Washington Street, PPIC: eight-storey office block of red-brown brick with deep punched windows, glazed shopfront, top storey set back behind a brick parapet; from Mapillary frames on Washington and Sansome (picks 0-1).

name: Grant Building
note: market-fidi.ts: Grant Building, 1095 Market at 7th: eight-storey 1905 red-brick loft with arched upper windows, dark shopfront, corbelled brick crown; Mapillary frame on Market (grant0).

name: Aida Hotel
note: market-fidi.ts: Aida Hotel, 1083-1087 Market: about seven-storey 1910s stucco hotel over a shopfront, flat parapet; Mapillary frame hidden by trees, massing from outline.
